title: LegalTech News – Lawyers Say Technology Improves Employee Satisfaction. So Why Are Firms Slow to Modernize?
summary: LegalTech News Reporter Rhys Dipshan covered Intapp's 2024 Technology Perceptions Report. His article covers the survey results including how lawyers at tech-savvy law firms say they are more satisfied in their jobs and more efficient at their work than those at less technology-forward firms.
